The source curriculum names Gratitude Journaling as a general skill. This focused Therapy Skill Kit exercise keeps the practice small and does not imply that gratitude should erase difficult experiences.

An entry can include what you noticed and, if you want, a small way to express appreciation or kindness. There is no requirement to share it with anyone. The optional prompt is informed by Greenberger and Padesky, [*Mind Over Mood*, second edition](https://mindovermood.com/worksheets/) (2016), Chapter 13.
